decided.singular: Isolated narrow spikes far above the local baseline (about 85-117 against a typical 10-30), plus the broad high excursion near days 68-70 that peaks around 95.
decided.highest: Q1 has repeated multi-day elevated episodes reaching 50-95 and a generally higher, more variable baseline than the rest of the year.
decided.lowest: Days about 185-215 and most of Q3 sit at a flat baseline of about 10-15 with few episodes, slightly below Q4's later baseline of about 20, though the margin is small.
decided.recurrence: Episodes appear at irregular intervals, mostly tens of days apart, and the trace at this resolution shows no consistent 5-10 day rhythm.

answer.guess: An air pollutant concentration (e.g. PM10 or NO2, in ug/m3) with winter/spring pollution episodes and short spikes such as New Year fireworks.
